wiki_text: Gasunie and Vopak (via EemsEnergyTerminal) took a conditional Final Investment Decision on June 1, 2026 to add a second FSRU at Eemshaven, converted by EXMAR (dual-fuel diesel-electric membrane LNG carrier conversion; ~750 MMscf/d regas plant ordered from Gas Solutions). The extension covers contracted capacity for 2028-2036, following a conditional charter party signed for both extending the existing FSRU and the newly-converted unit. Anticipated final configuration: two FSRUs owned/operated by EXMAR, combined storage ~190,000 m3, total regas capacity ~1,350 MMcf/d. Final (unconditional) FID remains contingent on permits.
